newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks lose ground on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks lose ground on profit-taking.

text.p: Tokyo stocks lost ground on Tuesday morning as profit-taking hit the market, brokers said. Despite the early losses, market sentiment remains firm as participants continue to pick up issues in sectors with favourable business conditions.

As of 0016 GMT, the Nikkei 225 average slipped 129.47 points or 0.69 percent to 18,621.18. Its March futures were down 70 points at 18,650. Brokers said concerns over the deteriorating health of China"s paramount leader Deng Xiaoping did not have an impact on the market, but added it may affect the market through a decline in Nikkei futures in Singapore.
